scripts.db:migrate:local: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply midnight-sensor-data --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply midnight-sensor-data --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.secret: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put PROOF_GATEWAY_TOKEN --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.secret:ingest: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put INGEST_API_TOKEN --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.secret:attestation: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put ATTESTATION_API_TOKEN --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.config:network: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put PUBLIC_MIDNIGHT_NETWORK --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.config:contract: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put PUBLIC_SENSOR_REGISTRY_CONTRACT_ADDRESS --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc && npm run db:migrate:remote
scripts.destroy: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler delete --config wrangler.jsonc --name midnight-proof-gateway && wrangler d1 delete midnight-sensor-data --config wrangler.jsonc --skip-confirmation
